subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Seven Gates of the Underworld
description: One-minute skill: Seven Gates of the Underworld.

hook.text: Inanna passed through seven gates to reach the underworld. At each gate, she lost a piece of her identity.

buildup.text: Crown, necklace, breastplate, belt, bracelet, measuring rod, robe—seven layers of power stripped away.

discovery.text: Dante has seven terraces in Purgatory. Seven deadly sins. The descent through seven is a universal pattern.

twist.text: Seven gates force transformation through loss. You can't descend and remain yourself. Each gate takes something.

climax.text: Seven marks the stages of spiritual stripping. To reach the bottom, you must lose everything you were above.

punchline.text: Seven layers off. Then you arrive naked.

quiz.question: What happened to Inanna at each of the seven gates?
options: She lost a piece of her royal identity
